p: The Cowgate is Kirkintilloch's main street, and it's the hub for shopping, cafés and pubs. The Auld Kirk Museum is on the Cowgate too, with displays about local history and the Roman Antonine Wall, which passed right through the town.

Kirkintilloch also likes to call itself the Canal Capital of Scotland, and the Forth and Clyde Canal runs through the town, so you can head out along the towpath for a walk or bike ride. Peel Park, on the site of the Roman fort, is nearby too.
Remember Wilmot's is an adult gaming centre, so it's 18+ only. ID helps if you look young.
